name: Medito
title: Medito: free Headspace alternative
hook: Headspace charges you twelve ninety nine a month to help you meditate. This app does it for free.

features.say: Follow a beginner course, or a daily session.
There are sleep stories and nature sounds to help you drift off.

install: Download from the App Store or Google Play
install_line: It runs on iPhone and Android. Just grab it free on the App Store or Google Play.
caption:
Headspace charges $12.99/month to help you meditate. Medito does it for free 🧘

✅ Beginner courses and a fresh daily meditation
✅ Sleep stories and nature sounds
✅ Breathing exercises and a meditation timer
✅ No ads, no account, no paywall, 100% free

📱 iPhone · Android
ℹ️ Heads up: Medito is run by a non-profit and funded by voluntary donations. Headspace's $12.99 is its monthly plan
